title: Mapping the DNA / Exploration Montage
slide_intent: Compare alternative expressions before selecting a direction so change can be judged against recognition and ambition.
strategic_value: Testing light, reflection, color and flowing forms can help Spectrum evolve its blue identity without losing a recognizable connection.
demonstration: A 17.50-second montage sequences advertising concepts in outdoor and interior settings, including prism-like light, pale reflective planes, blue flowing textures and multicolor currents.
practical_value: Compare the visual territories as exploratory proposals, not as a set of approved ingredients to combine.

content_islands.name: Light and reflection concepts
content_islands.spec: Begin with a large street-wall composition and smaller advertising studies pairing Life Unlimited with prismatic light and lifestyle photographs.

content_islands.name: Pale graphic concepts
content_islands.spec: Move through light-background layouts combining reflective shapes, devices and people.

content_islands.name: Current and environmental concepts
content_islands.spec: Finish with flowing blue and multicolor proposals placed in terminal, billboard and poster settings.

ingredient.name: Exploratory visual territories
ingredient.role: Make alternative routes to the brand idea comparable.
ingredient.application: Compare proposals for continuity, distinction and application before selecting a direction.
ingredient.scope: Agency exploration montage. These concepts are not all approved final identity assets.
